name: round-trip-every-transform
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): every transform of the table once: text 1, int -1, uint 2, float 3 (1.5 = f93e00), bytes 4 (0aff), bool flag (f5 -> 1), epoch_s 5 (1614456000 s -> 1614456000000 ms), uint via levels 6 (2 -> high), floats 7.1/7.2 (45.5 = f951b0, -90.25 = f9d5a4), text at 8.[1] (8.[0] is residue), the group 9 of maps; when 0 1 selects plain. Input is canonical, so output equals input. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
